expect_red: sweep: a body carries what is recorded INSIDE its matched occurrence -- the deepest enclosing claim wins, a listed claim beats an inherited one, and a sibling path is not inside

mutations.contract: A body carries the occurrences whose instance PATH lies under one of its matched occurrences -- a path prefix, segment by segment, never a name prefix.
mutations.note: The mutation reads a name prefix instead of a path, so `.../plate.30/...` counts as inside `.../plate.3` and a sibling assembly would swing with the plate.
